mimi_gpu.name: Pocket English Mimi continuous codec
mimi_gpu.cache: Original upstream linear KV cache, capacity max_frames*16+64
mimi_gpu.checkpoint_widening: BF16 to FP32, exact and identical to the historical CPU adapter
mimi_gpu.numerical_qualification: Passed original CPU ONNX comparison for all four fixed960ms sweeps on three clips in this run

provenance.postrun_artifact_check: All file sizes/mtimes unchanged; benchmark/package sources rehashed. Large model archives are not rehashed after timing.

protocol.order: For each clip and packet size, reverse complete arm order on clip+repetition parity. Each measured arm order occurs once in each direction.
protocol.reference: Each codec's original full CPU ONNX on exactly the cropped latents, with fresh state at the crop start.
protocol.sample_selection: Same shared-duration middle 960ms crop as benchmark_mps; aligned80ms, no context replay.
protocol.timing: Packet decode and flush calls, including owned input upload and completed CPU-ready output, API validation and synchronization. Audio first-packet lazy history allocation remains inside decode.
protocol.exclusions: Model/session/stream creation, stream-initialization synchronization, close, source hashing, reference comparison and reporting. First compiled public calls are separately reported including both compile and decode work.
protocol.boundary: All three Audio GPU arms use the same GPUDecoder API and finite validation of audio plus all26 histories. Mimi BasicGPUStream validates owned NumPy input/output and performs completed copy/sync, but omits all-history finite validation. CPU uses its selected streaming facade. These API validation boundaries are not identical across codecs.
protocol.aggregate: Pooled RTF uses packet+flush time divided by emitted duration; all repetitions retained.
protocol.performance_claim: Matched short comparison, no significance or overlap-only speed claim
